from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Request
from fastapi.openapi.utils import get_openapi
import yaml

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/v3/apps")

@router.get("/{app_client_id}/openapi.yaml")
async def export_client_app_openapi_yaml(
    app_client_id: str,
    request: Request,
    app_manager: ClientAppManager = Depends(get_client_app_manager),
    current_practitioner: MedicalPractitioner = Depends(get_current_practitioner)
):
    client_app = await app_manager.find_client_app(app_client_id)
    if not client_app:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Client application not found")

    specialized_routes = [
        r for r in request.app.routes
        if any(scope in client_app.enabled_scopes for scope in getattr(r, "scopes", []))
    ]
    schema = get_openapi(
        title=f"{client_app.app_name} Clinical API",
        version="3.0",
        routes=specialized_routes
    )
    schema["info"]["x-ehr-integration-key"] = client_app.ehr_system_id
    return yaml.dump(schema, sort_keys=False)

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Request
from fastapi.openapi.utils import get_openapi
import yaml

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/v3/apps")

@router.get("/{app_client_id}/openapi.yaml")
async def export_client_app_openapi_yaml(
    app_client_id: str,
    request: Request,
    app_manager: ClientAppManager = Depends(get_client_app_manager),
    current_practitioner: MedicalPractitioner = Depends(get_current_practitioner)
):
    client_app = await app_manager.find_client_app(app_client_id)
    if not client_app:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Client application not found")
    if client_app.organization_id != current_practitioner.organization_id and not current_practitioner.is_super_admin:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Forbidden: unauthorized to export OpenAPI contracts for external hospital applications")

    specialized_routes = [
        r for r in request.app.routes
        if any(scope in client_app.enabled_scopes for scope in getattr(r, "scopes", []))
    ]
    schema = get_openapi(
        title=f"{client_app.app_name} Clinical API",
        version="3.0",
        routes=specialized_routes
    )
    schema["info"]["x-ehr-integration-key"] = client_app.ehr_system_id
    return yaml.dump(schema, sort_keys=False)
